with inclusion as (
  select
    sum(n_total_reviewed) as postings_derived_pairs_reviewed,
    sum(n_canonical_auto_included) as canonical_pairs_retained,
    sum(n_non_canonical) as noncanonical_pairs_reviewed,
    sum(k_two_model_yes_pass) as agreement_retained_novel_pairs,
    sum(n_canonical_auto_included + k_two_model_yes_pass) as pairs_retained_by_procedure
  from usajobs.llm_judge_primary_inclusion_by_batch
),
cross_soc2 as (
  select
    sum(n_pairs) as cross_soc2_pairs_reviewed,
    sum(n_two_model_yes_pass) as cross_soc2_agreement_retained_pairs,
    sum(n_two_model_yes_pass) * 1.0 / nullif(sum(n_pairs), 0) as cross_soc2_yes_rate
  from usajobs.llm_judge_migration_accuracy_by_batch
  where migration_distance = 'cross_soc2'
),
overall_agreement as (
  select
    sum(n_complete_reviewed) as complete_reviewed_pairs,
    sum(n_unanimous_agreement) as same_verdict_pairs,
    sum(n_unanimous_agreement) * 1.0 / nullif(sum(n_complete_reviewed), 0) as same_verdict_rate
  from usajobs.llm_judge_reliability_by_batch
  where batch <> 'null'
),
null_baseline as (
  select
    max(case when stratum_label = 'All independently sampled pairs' then n end) as null_pairs_reviewed,

  from usajobs.llm_judge_null_baseline_summary
)
select *
from inclusion
cross join cross_soc2
cross join overall_agreement
cross join null_baseline

  select
    cast(task_id as integer) as task_id,
    min(occ8) as canonical_occ8
  from usajobs.onet_task_statements
  group by 1
)
select
  left(c.canonical_occ8, 2) as canonical_soc2,
  left(u.occ8, 2) as target_soc2,
  count(*) as n_pairs,
  count(distinct u.task_id) as n_tasks,
  count(distinct u.occ8) as n_target_occupations,
  sum(case when u.migration_distance = 'cross_soc2' then 1 else 0 end) as n_cross_soc2_pairs,
  sum(case when u.migration_distance <> 'cross_soc2' then 1 else 0 end) as n_within_soc2_pairs
from usajobs.llm_judge_agreement_retained_pairs_union u
join canonical_home c using (task_id)
where u.migration_distance <> 'canonical'
group by 1, 2
order by 1, 2

with canonical_home as (
  select cast(task_id as integer) as task_id, min(occ8) as canonical_occ8
  from usajobs.onet_task_statements
  group by 1
)
select
  left(c.canonical_occ8, 2) as canonical_soc2,
  left(u.occ8, 2) as target_soc2,
  count(*) as n_pairs,
  count(distinct u.task_id) as n_tasks,
  count(distinct u.occ8) as n_target_occupations,
  sum(case when u.migration_distance = 'cross_soc2' then 1 else 0 end) as n_cross_soc2_pairs,
  sum(case when u.migration_distance <> 'cross_soc2' then 1 else 0 end) as n_within_soc2_pairs
from usajobs.llm_judge_agreement_retained_pairs_union u
join canonical_home c using (task_id)
where u.migration_distance <> 'canonical'
group by 1, 2
order by 1, 2
